_about: The odd jobs (scripts/camp/camp_tasks.gd; the owner: gathering never gates anything, it is easy money any time, while guests' requests are the heart of the day): up to active_max counted tasks at once, shared by both players; either player's step counts. A task names an event (chop, fish, cook, give, spot, forage, build:<kind>; a plain name also counts its sub-events, so forage counts forage:stick) and how many make it done; done pays bonus coins at once and the next task takes its place. The firsts come first, once per camp, and teach the game on day 1; after them the daily tasks cycle forever. place tags where it happens (text: data/text.json task.place). news: the line the morning report gives about the day after (text: news.day_<n>), for each day number listed.
